## Attention

The scaling factor is $\frac{1}{\sqrt{d_k}}$, see [page 4](labshelf:vaswani2017#p4) and [@bahdanau2015; @luong2015].

$$
\mathrm{Attention}(Q, K, V) = \mathrm{softmax}\left(\frac{QK^T}{\sqrt{d_k}}\right) V
$$ {#eq-attention}
:::
